# Checkbox

Square checkbox (native input) with label and optional description; supports indeterminate.

`KenosUI.Checkbox` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Checkbox />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Checkbox"></x-import>
```

## Props (CheckboxProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Box 16 / 20 / 24px. Default "md". |
| `palette` | `"primary" \| "accent"` |  |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` | Muted second line under the label. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "size">._
